    Full-support envelopes of finite poset spaces #

    Every finite poset space embeds canonically into the poset space on the same ambient vector space whose distinguished subspaces are all full. This is the elementary envelope used to reduce Iyama essential surjectivity to closure of the restricted-Yoneda image under subobjects.
